audit.whatIsWrong: The page told the reader to hold Q to 'silence' and 'threaten' her Tomb self-cast.
audit.why: Kassadin's Q has no silence — Riot's text is damage plus interrupting channels — and Frozen Tomb's self-cast makes her untargetable and invulnerable, so no targeted ability reaches her at all. audit.corrected: Q reframed as poke and shield; Glacial Path's 24s downtime made the green light; the untargetable self-cast stated plainly.

audit.why: It is the numbers field, and Glacial Path's 24-second rank-1 cooldown is the single most actionable number in this lane.
audit.corrected: Glacial Path 24s to 12s; Ice Shard 7s to 3s; Ring of Frost 10s at 450 units; Frozen Tomb 120/100/80s.

FACT ERROR SHIPPED: the page told the reader four separate times to hold Q to 'silence' or 'threaten' her Frozen Tomb self-cast.
